title: Demo fixture vacancy requirements say "Single professional preferred" — civil status is an Equal Status Acts ground the fixtures header claims never appears
evidence:
+//// person's data. Emails use `example.ie`/`example.com`. Protected
+//// characteristics never appear as criteria (Equal Status Acts); the
+//// stories demonstrate only legitimate criteria: affordability, references,
+//// rental history, occupants, pets.
detail: vacancy_harbour_json's requirements field is "Sea view. Single professional preferred." — "single" names civil status, a protected ground. The showcase dataset contradicts its own compliance claim in user-facing demo copy.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the harbour requirements to a legitimate criterion (e.g. "Sea view. References required."), and sweep all fixture copy for ground-adjacent wording.

title: Design artifact claims a fetch-spy client test pins zero network requests; no such test exists — the flow tests never execute effects
evidence:
+

Everything resolves against an in-memory store; refresh or "Reset demo" wipes it. No request ever leaves the browser in demo mode — pinned by a client test.
detail: demo_flow_test.gleam's own header admits "Because Lustre effects are opaque to Node tests, the request→response bridge is exercised in two steps… The browser E2E (bug-hunt) covers the effect execution." The pinned guarantee shipped as a grep lint, not the claimed test.
recommended_fix: Correct the artifact claim, or add the promised bug-hunt scenario asserting zero /api requests during a demo walkthrough.

title: Guard detection is positional, not containment-based — a `case X.demo_mode` earlier in the same arm launders a later unguarded api call
evidence:
+def demo_guard_in_same_scope(lines, scope_start, call_idx):
+    """True when a `case <receiver>.demo_mode {` sits between scope_start and
+    call_idx at brace depth <= the call's own depth. Any receiver name
detail: The check only verifies a same-line `case …demo_mode` occurs between scope start and the call (`re.search(r"\bcase\b[^\n]*\.demo_mode", line)` + `if depth <= call_depth: return True`); it never verifies the call sits inside a guarded branch. A sibling case followed by an unguarded call passes.
recommended_fix: Track the brace span of each matched guard case and require the call line to fall inside one of its arms.

title: EXEMPT_ARMS is an unverified trust list — exempted arms skip guard checking on prose justification only
evidence:
+# Message arms whose real api calls are structurally unreachable in demo mode
+# (auth flows always exit the demo first; ApiReturnedSession/PolicyRefresh are
+# demo-guarded at the top of their handlers).
+EXEMPT_ARMS = {
detail: Unlike DEMO_INTERCEPTED (manifest-verified against demo_update.handle), EXEMPT_ARMS arms hit `scope_name in EXEMPT_ARMS … continue` with no mechanical check. Removing a demo guard from an exempted arm passes the lint silently.
recommended_fix: Require exempted arms to carry a verifiable demo guard, or bite-test that stripping an exempted arm's guard fails the lint.

title: Baked demo PDFs have no regeneration or freshness guard — fixture changes silently serve stale marketing reports
evidence:
+//// The applicant payloads below mirror the client fixture stories in
+//// `client/src/demo/` (same names, incomes, scores, flags). If the demo
+//// story changes, update BOTH sides — the PDFs are static assets and do
+//// not re-render themselves.
detail: JSON fixtures get a conformance suite; the PDFs get a manual-regen comment. The diff wires no CI step or test that runs pdf_prebake or validates the committed PDFs against the payloads.
recommended_fix: Emit a content manifest from pdf_prebake and add a CI check that the committed PDFs match a fresh bake.

title: CI success message asserts "no API/network imports in demo/" while the same step whitelists demo_api's fetch import
detail: The step's closing echo claims "Demo mode is fully client-side: no API/network imports in demo/…" — contradicted by the explicit demo_api.gleam fetch whitelist two lines up. Misleading green-build output.
recommended_fix: Reword the echo to state the actual contract: no API imports, one whitelisted static-asset fetch in demo_api.download.

evidence:

...

detail: No caller can pass props; every event fires with empty {}. The FFI's props_json parameter and its JSON.parse handling are unreachable capability, and the header's props claim is unimplemented.
recommended_fix: Either add a capture_event_with_props variant used by surface events, or drop the props plumbing and the header claim.

title: clear_demo_state resets every demo-populated data field but not toasts — demo notices survive the exit
evidence:
+pub fn clear_demo_state(model: Model) -> Model {
+  Model(
+    ..model,
+    demo_mode: False,
+    demo_store: None,
detail: The function clears vacancies through unread_count but leaves model.toasts untouched; a demo toast (e.g. the payments notice) follows the visitor onto /login or /signup after exit.
recommended_fix: Clear toasts (and scoring_status) in clear_demo_state alongside the other demo-populated fields.

title: pdf_prebake synthesizes emails from names instead of mirroring fixtures — O'Sullivan's PDF email differs from the on-screen one
detail: simple_row derives "conor.o'sullivan@example.ie" (apostrophe kept) while the client fixture and screen show "conor.osullivan@example.ie" — the PDFs don't mirror the stories the header claims they mirror.
recommended_fix: Carry the fixture email explicitly in ReportPayload/simple_row rather than deriving it from the name.

title: accepted_policy_version "match" is pinned against a hardcoded literal, not the real policy constant
evidence:
+/// Decode the mock landlord. `accepted_policy_version` matches the current
+/// server policy version (shared/policy_highlights) so the re-acceptance
+/// modal never fires inside the demo.
detail: The conformance test asserts should.equal("2026-05-23") — same literal as the fixture. When the server policy version bumps, both stay green and the demo starts firing the re-acceptance modal.
recommended_fix: Assert against the actual shared/policy_highlights current-version constant so a bump fails the conformance suite.
